# Handcrafted miniature travel landmark

[English](../README.md#user-content-case-miniature-travel-landmark) · [简体中文](../README.zh-CN.md#user-content-case-miniature-travel-landmark) · [繁體中文](../README.zh-TW.md#user-content-case-miniature-travel-landmark) · [日本語](../README.ja.md#user-content-case-miniature-travel-landmark) · [한국어](../README.ko.md#user-content-case-miniature-travel-landmark) · [Français](../README.fr.md#user-content-case-miniature-travel-landmark) · [Deutsch](../README.de.md#user-content-case-miniature-travel-landmark) · [Español](../README.es.md#user-content-case-miniature-travel-landmark) · [Português (Brasil)](../README.pt-BR.md#user-content-case-miniature-travel-landmark)

<a href="https://x.com/Naiknelofar788/status/2097646788258021837"><img src="https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HRxWoHva0AADhqK?format=jpg&amp;name=medium" width="640" alt="Handcrafted miniature travel landmark — @Naiknelofar788 — Source result" loading="lazy"></a>

Build a collectible landmark diorama with a travel plaque and a warm paper background.

**Original prompt · Text to image · Not independently tested**

### Required inputs

- Replace [ICONIC STRUCTURE], [STRUCTURE NAME], [CITY, COUNTRY], and [SHORT UNIQUE FACT] with the desired landmark and checked facts.

<details>
<summary>Prompt</summary>



```text
Create a charming handcrafted miniature travel scene featuring [ICONIC STRUCTURE] as the main focal point.
Show the landmark as a beautifully sculpted tiny 3D model, with soft rounded details, handmade textures, delicate imperfections, and a whimsical storybook feeling. Surround it with a few subtle elements that represent its location—such as tiny trees, flowers, streets, boats, mountains, clouds, or local objects—without making the scene crowded.

Place everything on a clean warm-white textured paper background, with plenty of elegant negative space. Add a small tasteful wooden or paper travel plaque containing:

[STRUCTURE NAME]
[CITY, COUNTRY]
Famous for: [SHORT UNIQUE FACT]

Use soft natural lighting, gentle shadows, pastel yet realistic colors, miniature diorama depth, handcrafted clay/paper textures, and a premium cute travel-journal aesthetic. Centered composition, highly detailed landmark, adorable but sophisticated, clean and collectible travel-card design, no photorealistic people, no clutter.
```

## 中文

<a href="https://x.com/Naiknelofar788/status/2097646788258021837"><img src="https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HRxWoHva0AADhqK?format=jpg&amp;name=medium" width="640" alt="手工微缩旅行地标 — @Naiknelofar788 — 来源结果示例" loading="lazy"></a>

制作一个包含旅行铭牌和温馨纸质背景的可收藏地标立体模型（diorama）。

**原始提示词 · 文生图 · 尚未独立测试**

### 输入要求

- 将 [ICONIC STRUCTURE]、[STRUCTURE NAME]、[CITY, COUNTRY] 和 [SHORT UNIQUE FACT] 替换为目标地标名称及经核实的信息。

<details>
<summary>提示词</summary>



```text
打造一个迷人的手工微缩旅行场景，以 [ICONIC STRUCTURE] 为视觉焦点。
将地标呈现为精美雕刻的微型 3D 模型，具有柔和圆润的细节、手工质感、细腻的微瑕美感以及充满童趣的故事书风格。周围点缀少量代表其地理位置的微妙元素——如微型树木、花卉、街道、船只、山脉、云朵或当地特色物品——保持场景简洁，避免拥挤。

将所有元素置于干净、暖白色且有质感的纸张背景上，留出优雅的留白空间。添加一块精致的木质或纸质旅行铭牌，内容包括：

[STRUCTURE NAME]
[CITY, COUNTRY]
Famous for: [SHORT UNIQUE FACT]

运用柔和的自然光、轻柔的阴影、柔和而逼真的色彩、微缩模型的景深效果、手工粘土/纸张质感，营造出高级可爱且充满旅行手账风格的视觉美感。采用居中构图，地标细节丰富，既可爱又精致，设计风格简洁且适合收藏，画面中不包含写实人物，无杂乱元素。
```

</details>
